_comment: STILL image generation (profile avatar, chat header, session bubble).
GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render is the reference image that
video.json requires, and the source tutor_images.py crops from.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
assistant's display name, because names are placeholders that can be
replaced. When renaming, pick a name that fits THIS file, not the reverse.
role: session assistant - welcomes the class, runs timekeeping, hosts the break Q&A and answers in private chat. Deliberately NOT styled as a teacher: no board, no chalk, no formal wear.

identity._heritage_note: Corrected 2026-07-30: she was cast Indian South African while carrying an isiXhosa name. The name is canonical (the app was fixed TO Thandi from this roster) and no portrait existed yet, so the appearance changed. Xhosa specifically: it is the second-largest language group in the country and was absent from all fifteen personas.
identity.build: tall and slim, narrow-shouldered, calm and still in the way she holds herself

face: long narrow face with high sharp cheekbones and a defined angular jaw, almond-shaped dark brown eyes set slightly deep, straight level brows, a narrow straight nose, a small neat mouth, deep brown skin with a cool undertone, a small mole on the left side of the chin just beside the mouth
hair: short tapered natural hair, dense and neatly shaped, a little longer on top; no braids, no weave - deliberately different from the other two hosts

wardrobe.default: simple long-sleeve top in dusty pink, sleeves worn down to the wrist; nothing corporate, nothing branded

presence.pose: sits or stands relaxed, leaning very slightly forward as if paying close attention; hands often resting one over the other, gesturing small when she speaks
presence.default_expression: calm and encouraging, a small closed-mouth smile - the face of someone who is not going to rush you
presence.energy: steady and reassuring; the host who makes a nervous student feel it is fine to ask
presence.spoken_register: clear, unhurried South African English, gently warm; never bubbly, never formal

continuity_anchors: small mole on the left side of the chin
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 22-26 year old Black South African woman, a friendly session host (not a teacher). long narrow face with high sharp cheekbones and a defined angular jaw, almond-shaped dark brown eyes set slightly deep, straight level brows, a narrow straight nose, a small neat mouth, deep brown skin with a cool undertone, a small mole on the left side of the chin just beside the mouth. Hair: short tapered natural hair, dense and neatly shaped, a little longer on top; no braids, no weave - deliberately different from the other two hosts. Wearing simple long-sleeve top in dusty pink, sleeves worn down to the wrist; nothing corporate, nothing branded. small gold stud earrings. Expression: calm and encouraging, a small closed-mouth smile - the face of someone who is not going to rush you. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, mottled mid-grey concrete-textured wall, softly lit and slightly out of focus. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, corporate stock-photo headset, call-centre imagery, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the stock-photo and call-centre terms are deliberate: prompts for a 'host' drift toward headset-wearing support-agent imagery, which is the wrong register

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, mottled mid-grey concrete-textured wall, softly lit and slightly out of focus
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

_distinct_from_other_hosts: Bianca: shoulder-length dark curls, freckling, silver studs. Mandy: box braids in a half-up bun, gold hoops. Thandi: short tapered natural, gold studs. A student meets only their own grade's host, but the three appear together on the team screen - they must read as three different people.
_matches_render: Matched to the FINAL regenerated portrait 2026-07-30. The Xhosa correction landed - short tapered natural, gold studs, thin gold chain, dusty pink top are all in the picture. Three fixes: the mole was recorded at the RIGHT jawline and sits on her LEFT beside the mouth (the same mirrored-anchor error as Mandy's, and it breaks the next generation the same way); the sleeves are worn down, not pushed up; and the backdrop is a mottled grey concrete wall, not seamless paper.
_distinct_from_mandy: REGENERATE HER (owner, 2026-07-30): Thandi and Mandy read as too similar in the face. The cause was in these files, not the model - both said 'oval face', 'dark brown eyes', 'deep-brown skin with a warm undertone', 'average height', with overlapping ages. The only things separating them were hairstyle and which side a mole sits on, and hair is exactly what changes between renders. Thandi is now structurally different where styling cannot mask it: long narrow face vs Mandy's round face with full cheeks; high sharp cheekbones and an angular jaw vs Mandy's soft rounded one; almond deep-set eyes vs Mandy's wide warm ones; cool skin undertone vs Mandy's warm; tall and slim vs Mandy's average build; 22-26 vs 24-29. Mandy's approved render is unchanged - she is the established default persona, and Thandi is the newer character, so Thandi is the cheaper one to redo.
